media.voiceHint: Optional. Voice name or ID of the provider (empty = the provider's default).
media.referencesHint: Optional: the AI edits or takes inspiration from these images (up to 3).
media.animateHint: Optional: the video starts from this image.
media.keepWorking: You can close this window: the video keeps being created.

creating.video: Creating your video… this can take a few minutes.

providers.adminOnly: Only admins can manage AI providers.
providers.emptyText: Add your own key from OpenAI, Claude, Gemini or another provider below to write posts and create images, videos and voice-overs.
providers.deleteText: “{name}” and its price list will be removed. Past costs stay in the reports.
providers.addHint: Bring your own key: you pay the provider directly, at their price.
providers.how1: The default provider writes posts, replies and ideas. Media goes to the first provider that can create it — or the model you pick.
providers.how2: Prices are approximate list prices used for estimates and budgets. You can edit them in each provider's price list.
providers.how3: Set a monthly budget to stop AI tasks once it is used up. Keys are encrypted and never shown again.
providers.keyHint: Paste the key from your provider account.
providers.keySavedHint: A key is saved. Paste a new one to replace it, or leave empty to keep it.
providers.name: Name
providers.budgetHint: Optional. AI tasks stop when it is used up.
providers.voiceHint: Voice name (OpenAI, e.g. alloy) or voice ID (ElevenLabs).
providers.baseUrlHint: Leave empty to use the official endpoint ({url}).
providers.maxTokensHint: Upper limit for the length of one AI answer.
providers.pricesHint: Approximate list prices in US dollars. They are used for estimates, budgets and the AI costs page.

brand.title: Brand kits
brand.subtitle: Logo, colours, font and voice of your brand — used by AI writing, images, templates and production.
brand.emptyText: Create one so every AI text and visual sounds and looks like your brand.
brand.name: Name
brand.voiceHint: Used for voice-overs (ElevenLabs voice ID or OpenAI voice name).
brand.toneHint: How the brand speaks, e.g. friendly, short sentences, no slang.
brand.visualStyleHint: Added to image and video prompts, e.g. warm natural light, earthy tones.
brand.usedFor: The default brand kit is applied automatically when the AI writes a post or a reply. Pick a kit in “Create with AI” to add its visual style to images and videos and use its voice for voice-overs.
